X-Science studio shader fork (xscience-gloss-1)
Based on 3Dmol.js 2.5.5, pinned upstream bundle and GLSL hashes in manifest.json.
Copyright 2026 Victor Xu for the studio shading changes, licensed under MIT.
Upstream BSD-3-Clause, EDTSurf and incorporated notices remain in this directory.

Changes: interpolate view-space normals in the Lambert and double-sided Lambert
shaders; add soft studio specular highlights, ambient fill and a subtle rim.
No deposited coordinates, geometry, camera controls or parser behavior changed.
Original opacity-squared alpha, fog, wireframe and AO semantics are retained.
This is illustrative studio lighting, not a physically based scientific simulation.

Source: https://github.com/Victor-Xu-1/X-UI/tree/main/src/vendor/3dmol
Build: scripts/build-protein-renderer.mjs verifies the immutable upstream inputs
and replaces four exact shader string literals at build time. Only the resulting
bundle is shipped. No runtime patches, external shader fetches or extra renderer.
To update upstream, replace the pinned inputs, re-establish unique literal matches,
review all four shaders and licenses, and verify both molecular consumers in Chrome.
